verdict.rationale: Cal.com's own overview says you can "share a booking link, connect your calendars, and let people pick a time without the back-and-forth." That claim is backed by schedules that set availability, a slots API returning open times per event type, calendar integrations such as Google Calendar, and booking by username and event slug. A community user reports happily using it in place of Calendly. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how the public booking page checks connected-calendar conflicts in real time, and independent hands-on confirmation of the link-sharing booking flow itself.
